roster.name: MTA
roster.note: FINAL (2026-07-30, retested 10 paths incl. /search/jobs?q=): every URL on careers.mta.org returns a Cloudflare interstitial (403, __cf_bm cookie) to every automated client, from two different networks — search paths, the JSON routes, robots.txt/sitemap.xml, AND individual job pages. Getting past it would mean defeating bot protection, so DO NOT RETRY SCRAPING. Two working routes instead: (1) seed_jobs.yaml — browse careers.mta.org/search/jobs?q=unifier by hand and paste postings in; (2) aggregator discovery once API keys are added, since MTA syndicates to Google Jobs.

roster.name: City of New York
roster.note: NYC DDC/DEP/Parks etc. post Unifier roles here (a "Unifier Coordinator" ran until 6/30/2026; a full-text unifier match was live 2026-07-20). Search echoes the query on zero-result pages (5x) so the plain keyword check would false-positive; instead the check_pattern fires when ANY result link (href with -jid-<id>) is server-rendered — a nonsense query renders zero of them (verified 2026-07-20).

roster.name: Foresee Consulting
roster.note: formerly 4C Team; Oracle Primavera PLATINUM partner, ~21 staff, Las Vegas — the practice is built on Unifier, so a strong employer fit. But they publish NO individual job listings anywhere (probe rounds 14-15, 2026-08-03): /careers/ 301s to /about/#careers, which is pitch copy only ("Why Work For Us?", "Excellent Compensation") naming zero roles; the sole apply route is mailto:careers@4cteam.com. Not on Greenhouse or Lever (both 404). CAUTION — *.applytojob.com answers 200 for ANY subdomain: a nonsense name returned the byte-identical JazzHR marketing page, so that 200 is a wildcard, NOT a board. Nothing to scrape; watch via discovery or apply by email.
